# A configuration is one of the project's own files, read through the project:
# a path outside it is refused before anything is read, and so is a file it
# names outside it. What sqlc refuses is the import's error, at the file and
# line; a configuration of two packages, or for an engine sngl:sql does not
# reach, is refused; and what the import leaves out it says.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check proj/up.sngl
stderr 'import "sql:../outside/sqlc.yaml": scheme "sql": sql:../outside/sqlc.yaml is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/escape.sngl
stderr 'sql:./escape/sqlc.yaml reads ../outside/schema.sql, which is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/broken.sngl
stderr 'broken/query.sql:2:8: column "nope" does not exist'

! sngl check proj/two.sngl
stderr 'sql:./two/sqlc.yaml declares 2 packages, and an import reads one'

! sngl check proj/engine.sngl
stderr 'sql:./engine/sqlc.yaml is written for clickhouse'

sngl check proj/notes.sngl
stderr 'query Copy is left out: :copyfrom is not one sngl:sql runs'

# A directory of queries, and a pattern, are read as sqlc reads them.
sngl check proj/dirs.sngl

# A query file names its schema in a directive, read relative to itself.
# The schema names the engine, SQLite where none of its files does, and a
# query file naming one overrides it.
sngl check proj/file.sngl
sngl check proj/pg.sngl
sngl check proj/override.sngl

! sngl check proj/mixed.sngl
stderr ' mixed/b.sql:1: sngl:engine mysql, where mixed/a.sql:1 says postgresql'

! sngl check proj/noschema.sngl
stderr 'sql:./noschema.sql names no schema: say where it is with `-- sngl:schema <path>`'

! sngl check proj/typo.sngl
stderr ' typo.sql:2: sngl:shema is no directive: a query file says sngl:schema, and sngl:engine to override its schema.s'

! sngl check proj/engine2.sngl
stderr ' engine2.sql:1: sngl:engine oracle is none of sqlite, postgresql, mysql'

! sngl check proj/escape2.sngl
stderr 'sql:./escape2.sql reads ../outside/schema.sql, which is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/broken2.sngl
stderr 'broken2.sql:4:8: column "nope" does not exist'

-- proj/up.sngl --
import db "sql:../outside/sqlc.yaml"

const x = 1
-- proj/escape.sngl --
import db "sql:./escape/sqlc.yaml"

const x = 1
-- proj/escape/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: ../../outside/schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- proj/broken.sngl --
import db "sql:./broken/sqlc.yaml"

const x = 1
-- proj/broken/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- proj/broken/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER NOT NULL);
-- proj/broken/query.sql --
-- name: Bad :one
SELECT nope FROM a;
-- proj/two.sngl --
import db "sql:./two/sqlc.yaml"

const x = 1
-- proj/two/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- proj/two/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER NOT NULL);
-- proj/two/query.sql --
-- name: All :many
SELECT id FROM a;
-- proj/engine.sngl --
import db "sql:./engine/sqlc.yaml"

const x = 1
-- proj/engine/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: clickhouse
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- proj/engine/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id UInt64) ENGINE = Memory;
-- proj/engine/query.sql --
-- name: All :many
SELECT id FROM a;
-- proj/notes.sngl --
import db "sql:./notes/sqlc.yaml"

const x = db.schema.length()
-- proj/notes/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: postgresql
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- proj/notes/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id bigint NOT NULL);
-- proj/notes/query.sql --
-- name: All :many
SELECT id FROM a;

-- name: Copy :copyfrom
INSERT INTO a (id) VALUES ($1);
-- proj/dirs.sngl --
import db "sql:./dirs/sqlc.yaml"

const x = db.Thing{id=1}

func count() int {
    match var all = db.allCall() {
        ok { return all.length() }
        failed { return 0 }
    }
}

func first() int64 {
    // Every column of one table, so the table's own struct.
    match var t = db.firstCall() {
        ok {
            if t == null {
                return 0
            }
            return t.id
        }
        failed { return 0 }
    }
}
-- proj/dirs/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: migrations
    queries: "queries/*.sql"
-- proj/dirs/migrations/001_things.sql --
CREATE TABLE things (id INTEGER NOT NULL);
-- proj/dirs/migrations/001_things.down.sql --
this is not SQL, and a down migration is not read
-- proj/dirs/queries/all.sql --
-- name: All :many
SELECT id FROM things;
-- proj/dirs/queries/first.sql --
-- name: First :one
SELECT id FROM things LIMIT 1;
-- proj/file.sngl --
import db "sql:./file/queries.sql"

const x = db.Thing{id=1}
-- proj/file/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema ../dirs/migrations

-- name: All :many
SELECT id FROM things;
-- proj/pg.sngl --
import db "sql:./pg/queries.sql"

// A bigint is PostgreSQL's int8, an int64, where SQLite has no bigint.
const x = db.Account{id=int64(1), name="a"}
-- proj/pg/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema schema.sql

-- name: Accounts :many
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = $1;
-- proj/pg/schema.sql --
-- sngl:engine postgresql
CREATE TABLE accounts (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL);
-- proj/override.sngl --
import db "sql:./override.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/override.sql --
-- sngl:schema ov/schema.sql
-- sngl:engine mysql

-- name: Things :many
SELECT * FROM things WHERE id = ?;
-- proj/ov/schema.sql --
-- sngl:engine postgresql
CREATE TABLE things (id bigint NOT NULL);
-- proj/mixed.sngl --
import db "sql:./mixed/queries.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/mixed/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema a.sql
-- sngl:schema b.sql

-- name: A :many
SELECT id FROM a;
-- proj/mixed/a.sql --
-- sngl:engine postgresql
CREATE TABLE a (id bigint NOT NULL);
-- proj/mixed/b.sql --
-- sngl:engine mysql
CREATE TABLE b (id bigint NOT NULL);
-- proj/noschema.sngl --
import db "sql:./noschema.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/noschema.sql --
-- name: All :many
SELECT 1;
-- proj/typo.sngl --
import db "sql:./typo.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/typo.sql --
-- sngl:schema dirs/migrations
-- sngl:shema dirs/migrations
-- proj/engine2.sngl --
import db "sql:./engine2.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/engine2.sql --
-- sngl:engine oracle
-- proj/escape2.sngl --
import db "sql:./escape2.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/escape2.sql --
-- sngl:schema ../outside/schema.sql
-- proj/broken2.sngl --
import db "sql:./broken2.sql"

const x = 1
-- proj/broken2.sql --
-- sngl:schema broken/schema.sql

-- name: Bad :one
SELECT nope FROM a;
-- proj/outside/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
-- outside/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE secret (id INTEGER);
